evaluation_rule: Evaluate in ascending precedence and select the first matching branch. Gates are conjunctive and unweighted; unavailable representative evidence never counts as a pass.

branches.select_when: Any integrity, stale-success, ownership, idempotency, publication atomicity, cleanup safety, or orphan-accounting hard gate fails on an exercised adapter, or no credible remote-worker path remains.
branches.required_consequence: Narrow or stop remote execution before production provider work; record the failed invariant and retained evidence.

branches.select_when: Core semantics pass locally but representative approved SSH/Linux evidence is unavailable, or reconnect, framing, credential mediation, or transport behavior dominates and prevents a transport-neutral conclusion.
branches.required_consequence: Carry only the state and ownership semantics to Gate 1; postpone SSH, gRPC, Connect, HTTP, framing, and reconnect-token encoding choices.

branches.select_when: All hard gates pass, but the E06 macOS stub requires session lifecycle fields or transitions that leak into or distort stateless Linux execution.
branches.required_consequence: Retain a common typed identity/event vocabulary while separating reusable worker, disposable sandbox, and optional stateful session protocols.

branches.select_when: All three adapter shapes, including a representative approved SSH/Linux worker, pass every hard gate and threshold through one core without provider option leakage or forced session semantics.
branches.required_consequence: Offer the proven semantic core as a Gate 1/T6 input only; keep transport, wire envelopes, adapter code, and compatibility experimental.
